name: Tricep Pushdown
common_faults: elbows moving forward and away from torso reducing isolation
not reaching full elbow extension at the bottom
using too much weight with upper-body momentum

substitutions.note: free weight; long head emphasis; greater overhead stretch
compound; adds chest and front delt demand

contraindications: elbow tendinopathy aggravated by loaded extension
resistance_profile: constant cable tension; hardest when elbow is at 90° where cable lever is longest relative to forearm

provenance.notes: Cable provides constant tension unlike free-weight pushdowns. Rope attachment allows neutral grip and wrist-friendly ROM. SFR heuristic for tricep isolation.
